Supply of Furniture for Government Schools

Date Posted12 Jul 2026
CategoryGoods
ProvincePunjab
LocationMultan
Last Date20 Aug 2026

Tender Description

The Education Department Punjab invites sealed bids from registered suppliers for the supply of school furniture including desks, chairs, and whiteboards for 50 government schools in Multan district.

The tender is open to all registered vendors with valid NTN certificates. Bids must be submitted in sealed envelopes addressed to the Director of Education, Multan.

A pre-bid meeting will be held on 25 Jul 2026 at 10:00 AM in the conference room of the Education Department.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Registered with Punjab Revenue Authority
  • Valid NTN certificate
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience

The department reserves the right to reject any or all bids without assigning any reason.
